annotations.title: Look up several Georgia Code sections

description: Several sections of the Georgia Code at once: a list ('44-7-30, 44-7-31 and 44-7-34') or a range ('44-7-30 through 44-7-35'), at most 40 sections and about 60,000 characters a call. A trailer names anything not in the Code and gives the call for any sections left over.

citations.description: A range ('44-7-30 through 44-7-35'), a list ('44-7-30, 44-7-31 and 44-7-34'), or a comma list of citations.
